docs.md_title: ISS Expedition 64 Spacewalk 73 Coverage - Part 03 of 05
docs.description: NASA TV (NTV) coverage of ISS Expedition 64 US Spacewalk 73 with Victor Glover (EV1), in the red striped Extravehicular Mobility Unit (EMU) and Mike Hopkins (EV2) in the all white EMU. Glover and Hopkins will vent and stow Early Ammonia System (EAS) Jumper; Remove and Replace (R&R) Node 1 Wireless Video System External Transceiver Assembly (WETA); troubleshoot Columbus (COL) Bartolomeo Payload Parking Position Interface (PAPOS) Connectors; reconfigure COL HAM Radio; install Airlock Thermal Cover Stiffener Installation; conduct Camera Port (CP) 8 Ethernet Cable Routing (Partially Completed); CP 9 Ethernet Cable Routing; and perform CP 9 External Television Camera Group (ETVCG) Lens Hood Adjustment (Get-Ahead). Includes footage of Glover and Hopkins as they complete their first task of venting and stowing Early Ammonia System (EAS) jumpers; International Space Station (ISS) Flight Control Room (FCR) with Flight Director Chris Edelen and CapCom Astronaut Andreas Mogensen, European Space Agency (ESA) as well as. Kathy Bolt; Glover at the Airlock as he prepares for next task to Remove Wireless Video System (WVS) External Transceiver Assembly (WETA) and install a spare WETA; and Hopkins by the Columbus module, where he works on PAPOS connectors; COL HAM reconfiguration; and Bartolomeo (BTL) clamp closure.
